Following AGENTS.md §7 I started at `code.md`, read the shop, character, levelup, types, index, game-api, game-console and character-state docs, then opened `levelup.ts`. I also grepped `game-console.component.*` and `game-api.service.ts`. I made no changes.

`POST /api/levelup` is the closest existing pattern, so the inn follows its shape. The shop endpoints are unusable and have no UI ([bugs.md B-02](../../../bugs.md)), so don't build on them.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId; characterId }`. Add a constant such as `INN_COST` (a flat value, or scaled by level, e.g. `5 * level`). |
| `worker/src/routes/inn.ts` (new) | Add `innRoutes` with `POST /rest`. It validates the body (400) and loads the character with `getCharacter` (404). It returns 400 if `hp >= max_hp` ("already at full HP"). It returns 400 if `gold < INN_COST`. It then calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - INN_COST })`. Worker code decides gold and HP, per AGENTS §9. The AI isn't needed. If you want a narrative, add one in `ai-dm.ts`. It returns `{ updatedCharacter, cost }`. |
| `worker/src/routes/inn.md` (new) | Doc per AGENTS §1 and §4. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `innRoutes`. Mount it with `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes)`. |
| `worker/src/index.md` | Add `/api/inn` to the Route mounts table and to Children. |

- **Combat check:** the route should reject resting while in combat. `inCombat` lives in the KV session (`CombatState`), so `loadSession` and `rebuildSession` from `services/session.ts` are needed. The frontend also hides the button in combat.
- **Logging:** optionally insert an `adventure_log` row (`actor 'system'`) and push to `session.history`, as `levelup.ts` does.
- **`services/character.ts`:** no change needed. `updateCharacter` already whitelists `hp` and `gold`. A `restAtInn()` helper there is optional.
- **Schema:** no migration. `characters` already has `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold`.

## Angular frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId): Observable<{ updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }>`, calling `POST ${API_BASE}/inn/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add `rest()`, modelled on `levelUp()` (line 183). It calls `api.rest`, then `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and `auth.updateCampaign` if needed. It pushes a narrative line. On error it shows `err.error.error`. Add an `resting` loading signal. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gold)" button in the left column beside the Inventory button (line 9). Show it only when `!charSvc.inCombat()`. Disable it when `resting()`, when HP is full, or when gold is below the cost. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add `'rest'` to the `jasmine.createSpyObj` method list (line 24). Add a test that it calls the API and updates the character. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Optional, for button styling. |
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Only if you add a `RestResponse` interface. Otherwise the inline type in `game-api.service.ts` is enough. |
| `character-state.service.ts` | No change. `setCharacter` already updates HP, gold and the signals. |
| `character-sheet.component.*` | No change. It re-renders from the signal. |

If the cost scales by level, mirror the formula or a shared constant on the frontend for the button label and disabled state. Nothing enforces the two copies matching, as `types/index.md` notes. The Worker stays authoritative.

- `worker/src/types/index.md`: add `RestBody` and `INN_COST`.
- `game-api.service.md`: add a row for `rest`, linked to `inn.md`.
- `game-console.component.md`: update Layout and Flow.
- `PRD.md`: update §4.4 (inventory & economy) and the API spec.
